notablePrerequisites:
Enchanted permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Estrid is not your commander.
The Peregrine Dynamo is enchanted.
description:
Activate Estrid's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing enchanted permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Estrid's ability.
Resolve the copy of Estrid's ability, untapping all enchanted permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.
